title: Mikrotik hAP ac2 RBD52G-5HacD2HnD-TC Ethernet Router

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The MikroTik hAP ac² RBD52G-5HacD2HnD-TC Ethernet Router is a high-performance dual-band WiFi router designed for reliable home and office internet connectivity in Bangladesh. It supports both 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequencies with 802.11a/b/g/n/ac standards, ensuring smooth browsing, streaming, gaming, and stable multiple device connections.


Powered by a quad-core ARM CPU and 128MB RAM, the hAP ac² delivers strong performance with five Gigabit Ethernet ports for wired connections, plus a USB 2.0 port for 3G/4G modem or external storage. The compact tower case design provides better cooling and can be wall-mounted for flexibility.


Ideal for Bangladeshi homes, offices, and SMEs, this router offers advanced MikroTik RouterOS features, including firewall, bandwidth management, VPN, hotspot, and QoS to ensure maximum control and security of your network.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: MikroTik hAP ac² (RBD52G-5HacD2HnD-TC)
  • CPU: 4-core ARM IPQ-4018, 716 MHz
  • RAM: 128 MB
  • Storage: 16 MB Flash
  • Wireless: Dual-concurrent 2.4GHz & 5GHz
  • 2.4GHz: 2x2 MIMO, up to 300 Mbps
  • 5GHz: 2x2 MIMO, up to 867 Mbps
  • Standards: 802.11a/b/g/n/ac
  • Ethernet Ports: 5x Gigabit RJ45
  • USB: 1x USB 2.0 (for 3G/4G modem or storage)
  • Antenna Gain:2.4 GHz: 2.5 dBi ,5 GHz: 2.5 dBi
  • Max Power Consumption: 21W
  • Power Options:24V 1.2A power adapter (included)
  • Passive PoE input (18–28V)
  • Operating System: RouterOS (License level 4)
  • Case Design: Compact tower case, desktop or wall-mountable
  • Dimensions: 34 x 119 x 98 mm
  • Weight: ~265g
